args.content:
import unittest

from shop import cart_total


class BulkDiscountTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_bulk_discount_over_ten(self):
        result = cart_total([("mug", 12)])
        self.assertEqual(result["discount"], 1440)
        self.assertEqual(result["total"], 12960)
        self.assertEqual(result["label"], "10% off")

    def test_no_discount_at_ten(self):
        result = cart_total([("mug", 10)])
        self.assertEqual(result["discount"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["total"], 12000)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

_LAST_PRICE = None


def price_of(sku):
    # Looks up one product's price in cents.
    global _LAST_PRICE
    if _LAST_PRICE is None:
        _LAST_PRICE = load_catalog()[sku]["price"]
    return _LAST_PRICE
